questions.question: A line in the xy-plane passes through the origin and has a slope of 1/7. Which of the following points lies on the line?
questions.explanation: The line is y = (1/7)x. For x = 21, y = 1/7 * 21 = 3, so (21, 3) lies on the line. The other points do not satisfy y = (1/7)x.
